name: pawify-api

scripts.build: npm run test:all && npm run build:unchecked
scripts.test:integration: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,firestore --project pawify-test "node --test lib-test/test/emulator/**/*.test.js"

_comment: Overrides: (1) gaxios/teeny-request still declare uuid ^9 (vulnerable per GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, fixed in >=11.1.1); scoped to them instead of global because universal-analytics needs uuid ^14 and a global override breaks the tree (npm ls ELSPROBLEMS). uuid is only used for request ids via uuid.v4(), API-stable across majors. (2) @opentelemetry/core ^2.8.0 fixes GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf for @google-cloud/pubsub (via firebase-tools); validated: npm ls exits 0 and npm run verify passes.
